1
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, November 22, 2011/Agrahayana 1, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Drinking Water and Sanitation; Environment and Forests; Finance;
Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Rural Development)
Total number of questions — 20
NOC for Greenfield International
Airport at Navi Mumbai
†*1. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  the State Government  of
Maharashtra has submitted any proposal
to his Ministry for the approval of  Terms
of Reference (TOR) and NOC for the
construction of Greenfield International
Airport at Navi  Mumbai, Maharashtra;
(b) if so, by when  the said proposal is
likely to get sanction and receive NOC;
(c) whether  the Ministry  is not clearing
the said  proposal for many years inspite
of the fact that it has been sanctioned by
the Central Government; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Exploration  of Shale Gas reserves in
the country
*2. SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India is the third country in
the world after US and Canada which has
Shale Gas reserves over 12,000 sq. km.;
(b) whether its exploration has been
allocated through bidding; and
(c) how far Shale Gas reserves would
reduce dependency on imports by the end
of the Twelfth Five Year Plan as presently
80  per cent of country's petroleum
requirements are met through imports?
Roadmap for improving productivity
of banking sector
*3. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR:  Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that Government
has prepared  a roadmap for improving  the
productivity of the banking sector in the
country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

2
Forest  cover in the country
*4. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA:  Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the forest area lost due to
globalization, industrialization,
urbanisation and exploitation  of coal mines
in the last three years, State-wise; and
(b) the new forest area created through
plantation in the last three years, State-
wise?
Observations of Goldman Sachs
regarding growth of Indian economy
*5. SHRI BAISHNAB PARIDA:  Will
the Minister of FINANCE  be pleased   to
state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that global
banking giant, Goldman Sachs, has said
that there is a downside risk to the Indian
economy and the RBI may have to further
lower the 7.6 per cent  growth projected
for this fiscal;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
improve the Indian economy?
Scarcity of water in wildlife
sanctuaries
*6. DR. K.V.P. RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that deaths of
wild animals and birds have been reported
from wildlife sanctuaries in the country due
to acute  scarcity  of water in the recent
past;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by Government to protect them in
these sanctuaries?
Hike in prices of petrol
 *7. SHRI N. BALAGANGA:  Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government  has increased
the petrol  prices recently;
(b) if so,  the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the details  of the number of times
and the quantum of increase in petrol prices
made during the last  two years and the
current year?
Collection of Central taxes from
Punjab
*8. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of revenues in the shape
of the Central taxes collected from the State
of Punjab directly or indirectly during each
of the last three years; and
(b) the allocations made by the Centre
to the State during this period?
Skill upgradation of doctors
*9. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR:  Will the
Minister of HEALTH  AND FAMILY
WELFARE  be pleased to state   the
corrective  action taken  by the Ministry in
co-ordination with the Medical Council of
India (MCI) and State Governments on the
fact that after getting medical degree, many
allopathic doctors are not updating their
knowledge and skills about the effect of
climate change on human body, changing
pattern of diseases,  drug resistance, germs,

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
latest scientific medical instruments and
latest medicines; and
(b) whether as a result, particularly the
poor and middle class families are not
getting the best medical treatment and in
some cases, it results in fatality?
Tax treaty with foreign countries
*10. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  Government has entered
into any tax treaty with Swiss Government
and 15 more foreign countries  on Tax
Information Exchange Agreement  (TIEA)
which will allow India to seek specific
information on black money and tax
evasion cases;
(b) if so, how many countries  have so
far shared the data with India on tax evasion
on account of the black  money stashed
abroad; and
(c) the details of Indians who have
stashed  money abroad, country-wise?
Inspection of MGNREGS accounts by
the Government Auditors
*11. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has invited the
Government Auditor to inspect the
accounts of the Mahatma Gandhi National
Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
(MGNREGS);
(b) if so, the time by when the
Government Auditor proposes to inspect
the accounts of MGNREGS in various
States and submit detailed report to the
Centre;
(c) whether the Central Government
proposes to ensure that the funds allocated
to States/UTs under the Scheme are utilised
in a transparent manner; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Black money deposited in foreign
banks
*12. PROF. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has received
details of 9900 persons, who have
deposited black money in foreign banks,
and whether Government is examining
those persons;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has formulated
any plan to check accumulation of black
money in the country and, if so, the details
thereof; and
(d) the quantum of black money seized/
traced during the last two years?
Rise in loans taken by PSBs
from RBI
†*13. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken note
of surge in loans taken from the Reserve
Bank of India (RBI) by the Public Sector
Banks (PSBs) by mortgaging Government
securities;
(b) if so, the details thereof during each
of the last three years and current financial
year, bank-wise;
(c) the reasons for the increase in the
loans taken during the said period; and
(d) the details of impact on economy as
a result of this market intervention?

4
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Allocation of funds under PMGSY and
IAY
*14. SHRI Y . S. CHOWDARY: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the basis for allocation of Central
funds to various States under Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) and
Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY);
(b) the details of funds allocated to
Andhra Pradesh under these schemes
during the Tenth Five Year Plan and in
Eleventh Plan so far, year-wise and
scheme-wise and  also in the country during
the period;
(c) whether the allocated funds in
Andhra Pradesh have been spent for the
specified purpose and, if so, the results
achieved thereof, year-wise and scheme-
wise; and
(d) whether any complaints of
diversion/misuse of funds came to the
notice of Government and, if so, the details
thereof and action taken thereon?
Anti-inflationary measures by RBI
*15. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the anti-inflationary
measures taken by the Reserve Bank of India
(RBI) have failed to make the desired effect;
(b) if not, how far these have been
successful in controlling the inflation;
(c) the impact of trading off higher
inflation for higher growth in the long run;
and
(d) how the detrimental effects thereof,
if any, will be countered?
Installation of hand pumps under
NRDWP
*16. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DRINKING WATER
AND SANITATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of norms fixed for
installation of hand pumps under the
National Rural Drinking Water Programme
(NRDWP);
(b) whether Government has received
any proposal from the State Government
of Himachal Pradesh regarding relaxation
of such norms; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Mosquito menace and dengue cases in
the country
*17. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the latest position with regard to
mosquito menace and dengue cases in the
national capital as well as other parts of
the country;
(b) the areas identified and measures
taken to contain the problem;
(c) the results achieved so far; and
(d) whether there have been complaints
of fake implementation of the programmes?
Selling of Government procured
medicines at cheaper rates
†*18. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
procured medicines are being sold at
cheaper rates in markets in Delhi;

5
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 16th November, 2011 Secretary-General.
Kartika 25, 1933 (Saka)
(b) whether any enquiry has been
conducted and culprits have been nabbed;
and
(c) if so, whether the persons involved
in it at every level have been identified and
what action is being taken against them?
Allocation of CNG at APM rates to
Gujarat
*19. SHRI DILIPBHAI PANDYA: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in Delhi and
Mumbai natural gas at APM rate is
allocated for providing CNG in the
transportation sector, which has proved to
be very economical as compared to other
major cities of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry has received
any proposal from the State Government
of Gujarat for allocation of gas at APM rates
for the transportation sector in the State on
the pattern of Mumbai and Delhi; and
(d) if so, the response of Government
thereto and action taken so far in this
regard?
Tax collection from petroleum sector
*20. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount of tax collected
from petroleum sector  during the last three
years;
(b) the details of amount realised
through different sources of tax;
(c) whether Petroleum companies have
handed over dividend or any type of share
of profit to Government during the last
three years; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Drinking Water and Sanitation : 16,
Environment and Forests : 1, 4, 6,
Finance : 3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 13, 15, 20,
Health and Family Welfare : 9, 17, 18,
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises:—
Petroleum and Natural Gas : 2, 7,19,
Rural Development : 11, 14.
6
GMGIPMRND—2387RS—16-11-2011.
